ruling: Accept fixed layout rectangle numbers alongside fixed semantic categories for one diagnostic probe. These describe browser hit-test obstruction, not DOM content, item metadata, URLs, credentials or account values. No click bypass or product acceptance is authorized.
prior_contract: Earlier probe restricted persisted data to enums/counts/booleans; this explicitly amends only layout geometry for obstruction diagnosis.
risk_and_limit: Coordinates describe viewport layout. If field content or unrestricted attributes appear, refuse retention; keep Vault contents and screenshots excluded.
